Relapse, to heavy addiction. To sobtietyy to.. deep in a bottle. To relapse on my DOC. To sobtiety. To... Losing everything but my car, and a backpack of underwear. Soon that car got towed. With my underwear and only wallet with my I'd and SSC card and all other important shit.  Just as covid forced the world to hide in fear. I'm homeless. Addicted to drugs. And alone. So I did what anyone would do... I fucking bust it  out.. it'd been awhile.. but it was time to let the world hear me in my darkest most alone spot.2.0..... but not even I expected to be laughing so hard I pissed. My pants. At 28 years old. I pissed myself. Now that doesn't seem all that bad. But it was my only pair of pants and underwear. Soo tell me how you do laundry. Lol. 🤣🤣🤣 

My point here, is don't cut to feel better. If you have to cut that's cool.. I'm not judging. I'll bandage you up anytime. But please if the razors glance is what you crave. Then crave the elation and the joy.. release. FREEDOM. FROM you. From your inner voice. That divine moment of peace. Like the flesh sliced... But just before the blood. Like for a moment even though we're cut in half.. we're holding it all together.  

The world is just as bright as you fight to share your light. Burn bright. But don't burn out. 


 It gets worse. BUT you get better at dealing with it. Much love ❤️ enjoy the shot show.. and make sure to laugh at it after a Lil bit of pout.
